text:
nora: Heads-up team 00:00 UTC deploy incoming for v2.6.3. We're toggling feature flag `llm-route-next` with a cautious cohort ramp. change window 20:00-21:00 UTC. deploy-bot please enqueue.

deploy-bot: Deploy job #D-100900 scheduled by nora for 20:00 UTC. Plan: cohorts 1% -> 8% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 9m holds. Will emit telemetry tags.

sam: Short and sweet 0: what's the explicit abort checklist?

nora: Abort if 5m error rate >1.6x baseline OR sustained p95 >420ms for 3m OR customer 5xx >=0.5%. On abort: `deploy-bot abort D-100900` then `scripts/pin_version.sh router v2.6.2` and set `llm-route-next=false` across cohorts.

eli: Add a shard-level partial rollback: if only one shard shows problems, we can restrict flag to exclude that shard id via `flags.exclude_shards` before full backout. Saves a full service pin.

tia: I'll take infra watch. Ops, can you silence the noisy paging slack for the window? Keep SEV1s.

ops-bot: Muting channel alert group "noisy-alerts" for 70m from 20:00 UTC. SEV1/SEV2 still posted.

qa-bot: Reminder: notify support with release blurb: "v2.6.3 routing tweaks + staged llm-route-next. Rollback criteria posted in eng-releases."

nora: Ramp matrix (copy):
```
step A: cohort=dev-canary (1%) - hold 9m
step B: cohort=early-adopters (8%) - hold 9m
step C: cohort=eu-region (25%) - hold 9m (reduce cache-ttl to 25s)
step D: cohort=na-region (60%) - hold 9m (scale cache-ttl back later)
step E: full (100%) - monitor 20m
backout: flags set to false + pin router v2.6.2
```

sam: Owners?

nora: I'll own A+B. eli takes C+D. sam final-checks for E. tia + ops watch infra and token throughput. If token throughput >1.9x projected, abort and investigate.

deploy-bot: Kicking off step A in 20s: `scripts/rollout_toggle.sh llm-route-next dev-canary true`

deploy-bot: Step A complete at 20:00:22  cohort=dev-canary (1%). tags: D-100900 step=A

tia: +4m: p50 +6ms, error rate normal. moving to step B in 90s.

eli: note for step C  if cache-ttl flip causes KV mismatch, use `scripts/kv_sync_check.sh eu-region` before enabling full 25%.

sam: good call. Also keep the emergency commands handy: `deploy-bot abort D-100900` and `scripts/pin_version.sh router v2.6.2`.

(End of thread)
